manifest.name: dsh-codemode
manifest.description: Code Mode preset for DeepSeek Harness: tools the preset's own composition does not register (MCP servers, profile-level plugins, per-agent tool sets) are kept out of context, and a plugin-owned code_run transport discovers and calls them.

bundle.text:
# AUTO-GENERATED by tools/gen-preset.mjs — do not edit by hand.
# Source: @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app@0.2.2-alpha.3/presets/standard.patch.yml
# Generated: 2026-11-03T15:24:03.134Z
#
# This bundle layer inserts one row: the `codemode` agent preset. Its plugin list
# mirrors the shipped `preset-standard` row captured above, plus one row of its
# own — this package, which supplies the `code_run` program transport, masks
# every tool the preset's own composition does not register (MCP servers,
# profile bundles, per-agent tool sets) out of the request surface, and
# registers the discovery tools a program uses to find and call them.
#
# Native tool execution is not restated here: `dsh-base` already mounts the
# `tool-executor-native` row for every profile. The deprecated
# `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-tool-presentation` row is intentionally absent — DSH
# 0.2.2 dropped it from the base/web-app dependency graphs, and a row naming an
# uninstalled package fails the whole preset activation, not just that row.
#
# Re-run `node tools/gen-preset.mjs <path>` after a DSH upgrade to re-sync the
# standard rows; the input must be the shipped standard.patch.yml of that release.
- insert:
    - id: preset-codemode
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: codemode
        name: "Code Mode（代码编排）"
        description: "标准模式 + code_run：标准工具照常直接调用，预设自身清单以外的工具（MCP、插件）不进上下文，由程序按需发现与调用。"
        order: 9
        plugins:
          - id: persona
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
            config:
              prefix: You are a coding agent powered by the {{model}} model.
          - id: agent-instructions
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
            config:
              maxBytes: 65536
          - id: time-context
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'
          - id: tool-bash
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
            disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
          - id: tool-pwsh
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
            disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
          - id: tool-fs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
            config:
              # Set false to drop the apply_patch tool beside edit.
              applyPatch: false
          - id: tool-fs-search
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
            config:
              sampleOverCapGlobResults: false
          - id: tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'
          - id: tool-schedule
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-schedule'
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'
          - id: command-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-goal'
          - id: tool-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-goal'
          - id: planning
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              planMode: true
            config:
              - id: plan-mode
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode'
                config:
                  section: |
                    You are in plan mode. Stay in plan mode until the user approves your plan through exit_plan_mode or switches the session mode. Imperative language to implement changes means plan the implementation, not execute it. A user's conversational agreement — including an answer confirming something you asked — approves nothing and does not end plan mode; fold the confirmed decision into the plan and submit it through exit_plan_mode.

                    Explore first. Use non-mutating reads, searches, static analysis, and checks to ground the plan in the actual repository. Do not edit or write files, change configuration, run formatters or code generation that rewrites tracked files, commit, or otherwise carry out the plan. Prefer existing functions and patterns over new machinery.

                    The tool catalog stays the same across modes for request-cache stability. These plan-mode rules override any later tool description or guidance that suggests using mutation tools; those tools remain listed to keep the tool catalog unchanged. Do not use todo_write to track this planning phase: it tracks implementation after an approved plan, while the plan itself belongs in exit_plan_mode.

                    Resolve discoverable facts by inspection. Use ask_user_question only for user-owned choices or material ambiguity that inspection cannot answer. Do not ask the user where code lives or how current behavior works when you can find out.

                    Make the plan decision-complete: state the goal and success criteria; group implementation changes by subsystem; identify public API, schema, and data-flow changes; cover edge cases, failure modes, tests, acceptance criteria, and explicit assumptions. Keep it concise enough to review but detailed enough that another engineer can implement it without making design decisions.

                    When ready, call exit_plan_mode with the complete plan markdown, starting with a # title. Make exit_plan_mode the only and final tool call in that assistant response: it presents the plan for approval, and implementation begins only in a later step after approval. Do not paste the final plan as a plain reply or ask "should I proceed?" through prose or ask_user_question. If review rejects it, incorporate the feedback and present again. If the review channel is unavailable or aborted, stay in plan mode and ask the user to switch modes manually; do not proceed with implementation.
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'
              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:
                  thresholdChars: 8192
                  headChars: 4096
                  tailChars: 1024
          - id: delegation
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              workflowEngine: true
            config:
              - id: tool-subagent-control
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control'
              - id: tool-subagent
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: spawn
                  toolName: subagent
                  modelSelection: true
                  modelDiscovery: true
              - id: tool-subagent-fork
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: fork
                  toolName: subagent_fork
              - id: workflow-ptc
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow-ptc'
                config:
                  provider: spawn
              - id: tool-workflow
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-workflow'
          - id: tool-ask-user
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user'
          - id: tool-todo
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo'
            config:
              allowParallelInProgress: true
          - id: tool-web
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
            config:
              fetch: true
              searchTimeoutMs: 60000
          - id: present
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-present'
          - id: tool-plugin-manager
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager/tools'
            disabled: !!js "!ctx.get('profileContext')"
          - id: tool-plugin-market
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market/tools'
            disabled: true
          - id: codemode
            name: 'dsh-codemode'
            config:
              # Tool-name prefixes kept out of the request surface.
              hiddenPrefixes:
                - 'mcp__'
              # Mask every tool the registry does not resolve from this
              # preset's own scope: MCP servers, profile-level plugin
              # bundles, and per-agent tool sets. What stays in the request
              # is the standard composition plus this package's transport.
              nativeScope: true
              # Explicit exceptions, by exact tool name:
              #   nativeTools: ['load_workspace_dependencies']
              #   hiddenTools: ['subagent_codex']
              nativeTools: []
              hiddenTools: []
              # Name of this package's own transport tool. It cannot be
              # `run_code`: the registry reserves that name for the built-in
              # PTC transport and rejects a registration that shadows it.
              runToolName: code_run
              # Discovery tools, callable only from inside a program.
              metaTools:
                - code_tools_list
                - code_tools_search
                - code_tools_describe
                - code_debug
              # Search page size and the description truncation used when
              # the listing is rendered into the prompt.
              searchLimit: 8
              maxDescriptionChars: 240
              # Concurrent sub-calls issued by one program.
              maxParallelSubCalls: 10
              # Reject a model-direct call to a masked name, and replace the
              # executor-provided `tools:sdk` section with the Code Mode one.
              guard: true
              sdkSection: true
              # Keep the recent assembly decisions for `code_debug`.
              debug: true

readme.text:
[English](./README.en.md) | **简体中文**

一个面向 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）的
**Code Mode** 智能体预设：标准工具照常原生调用，**本预设清单以外的工具**（MCP 工具、
profile 级插件、按 agent 注册的工具集）被挡在**模型上下文之外**，只由一个额外的
`code_run` 工具从程序内部按需发现与调用。

设计上参考了 pi 的 codemode（`mode: on` + MCP 延迟暴露），但实现建立在 DSH 自带的 PTC 运行时之上，而不是另起一套沙箱。

- **标准工具与标准模式一致**，原生直接调用，schema 不变。
- **本预设不拥有的工具一律不进上下文**，由程序内部发现和调用：
  ```js
  const { tools: hits } = await tools.code_tools_search({ query: 'okx ticker', limit: 5 })
  // hits[0].name、hits[0].description、hits[0].parameters（完整 JSON Schema）
  return await tools[hits[0].name]({ instId: 'BTC-USDT' })
  ```
  判定依据是**注册作用域**，不是名字前缀：本预设自身的插件行注册在预设作用域里，保持原生；
  MCP 服务端与 profile 级 bundle 注册在全局层，按 `agent.ctx` 注册的工具集（如 Agent Teams、
  定时任务）落在 agent 层，两者都被遮蔽。名字规则（`hiddenPrefixes`、`hiddenTools`、
  `nativeTools`）仍然生效，可用来加例外。
- 其他模式（`standard`、`ptc`、`minimal`、`cordis`）不受影响：那些模式下所有工具仍以原生方式呈现。

| 插件线 | 目标 DSH | 程序入口 |
|---|---|---|
| `0.3.x`（`main`） | **0.2.2-alpha.3 及以后** | 本包自带 `code_run` 传输 + **插件自带的 `ToolExecutor`**（遮蔽的唯一接缝） |
| `0.2.x`（分支 `0.2.x`） | **0.2.1 整线**（`>=0.2.1-alpha.5 <0.2.2-0`） | 本包自带 `code_run` 传输；遮蔽靠预设行 `mode: native` + `system-prompt/assemble` 瀑布 |
| `0.1.x`（分支 `0.1.x`） | 0.2.0-rc.2 | 内置 `run_code`（由 `both` 附带），本包不注册传输 |

三条线对外行为一致：标准工具原生，预设自身清单以外的一切（MCP、profile 级插件、按 `agent.ctx`
注册的工具集）都只能从程序内部调用。

**为什么分成 `0.2.x` 与 `0.3.x` 两条线。** DSH `0.2.2-alpha.2` 重做了工具呈现，
`0.2.x` 线的四个承重点同时失效，且都是静默失效：

| `0.2.x` 线依赖 | 0.2.2+ 的现实 |
|---|---|
| `system-prompt/assemble` 瀑布的 `assembly.tools` | 不再传入；瀑布后才由 provider 结果接回，钩子改不动工具列表 |
| `ctx.tools.execute({callId,name,arguments,...})` | 改为批量 `{calls,agent,signal}` |
| `ctx.tools.executionMode(input)` | 移除，迁至 `ToolExecutionPipeline.executionMode()` |
| 预设行 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-tool-presentation` `mode:native` | 包已废弃且不再是 `dsh-web-app`/`dsh-base` 的依赖；缺失时整行 `never started`，**预设激活失败** |
| 快照行 `dsh-tool-subagent-control/list-agents` | `exports` 已无该子路径，同样导致预设激活失败 |

`0.3.x` 把接缝换成 **插件自带的 `ToolExecutor`**（`ctx.tools.setExecutor()`）：注册表向当前
作用域的 executor 要模型可见的 schema，所以 `describe()` 就是请求面——这正是遮蔽要的东西，
而且比旧钩子更正当（它是这块的官方归属者）。两条线的安装与配置方式一致，口径与命令见
[docs/internals.md](./docs/internals.md#验证)。

本地开发时改用 `link:` 指向检出目录即可：
```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:<path-to-the-checkout>"
```

`cordis.patch.yml` 负责挂载本预设；修改 `codemode` 这一行的 `config` 即可调整行为
（`null` 或省略表示使用默认值）：

| 键 | 默认值 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `nativeScope` | `true` | 遮蔽一切不是本预设自身作用域注册的工具（MCP、profile 级插件、按 agent 注册的工具集） |
| `hiddenPrefixes` | `['mcp__']` | 额外剥离的工具名前缀 |
| `nativeTools` | `[]` | 例外：这些名字始终原生呈现（`run_code` 与 `runToolName` 永远原生） |
| `hiddenTools` | `[]` | 例外：这些名字始终遮蔽 |
| `metaTools` | `[list, search, describe, debug]` | 发现工具名；第一个同时用作 codemode 标记 |
| `runToolName` | `code_run` | 本包传输工具的名称（不可用保留名 `run_code`） |
| `searchLimit` | `8` | `code_tools_search` 默认返回的行数 |
| `maxDescriptionChars` | `240` | 列表中描述文本的截断长度 |
| `maxParallelSubCalls` | `10` | 一个程序内可并发的只读子调用上限 |
| `guard` | `true` | 拒绝模型对被遮蔽工具的直接调用 |
| `sdkSection` | `true` | 注入 / 替换 Code Mode 说明段落 |
| `debug` | `true` | 注册 `code_debug` 工具 |

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-codemode
```

预设行位于本 bundle 的 patch 层中，会随包一起消失。profile 之外的任何内容都未被改动。

- **作用域判定依赖一处 DSH 内部结构。** 注册表没有公开「某个工具注册在哪个作用域」的 API，
  本包因此按符号描述 `dsh.scope` 读取 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope` 写在 scoped context 上的标签，
  再用公开的 `ctx.tools.get(name, scope)` 做归属判断（`lib/scope.js`）。读不到标签时（例如把本包
  挂在 host 层而不是预设里）作用域规则自动失效，只保留名字规则并打出一次 warn，不会误遮蔽。
  「注册表解析不出的名字」也保持原生——那是别的 prompt provider 贡献的 schema，谁也不拥有它，
  只遮蔽能确认归属的工具。
  自 `0.3.x` 起还多一层约束：executor 的 `describe()` 拿不到调用方的 agent scope，所以**入参本身就
  是 agent 视图**——凡既不在全局视图也不在预设视图里的名字，只可能注册在预设之下（agent 层），
  据此判定（`resolveCatalogView`）。这比旧钩子更精确，因为它读的是注册表实际交来的那份定义集。
- **预设清单内的插件行算「标准」。** 判定是「本预设自己注册的」而不是「随 DSH 发布的」：
  往 `cordis.patch.yml` 的插件列表里加一行，它注册的工具就和标准工具一样保持原生；需要遮蔽时
  用 `hiddenTools`。反过来，只要插件挂在 profile（`dsh plugin add`），它的工具就在全局层或
  agent 层，会被自动遮蔽。
- **`0.3.x` 自带一份 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-executor-native` 依赖。** executor 必须能真正执行
  工具，而 profile 插件解析不到宿主的内核包，所以本包把该执行器作为真实依赖装上，用它的
  executor 驱动宿主注册表（跨两份独立模块图已验证）。副作用是安装多约 19 个包 / 6.6 MB。
  执行本身仍然委托给它，本包不重写 pre-policy / 审批 / around-dispatch / post-execute 管线——
  手写一份管线正是插件静默丢掉策略的方式。
- **子调用调度是本包自己实现的。** 内置传输通过私有的 `TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER` 接入 agent
  loop 的调度器；本包按工具定义的 `isConcurrencySafe` 复刻同一份可观察契约
  （`exclusive` 串行成屏障、`parallel` 按 `maxParallelSubCalls` 限流）。差别在于：本包的池
  只对**同一程序内**的子调
工作原理、常驻环境生命周期、验证与升级流程见 [docs/internals.md](./docs/internals.md)。

[简体中文](./README.md) | **English**

A **Code Mode** agent preset for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH):
the standard tools stay natively callable, while **every tool this preset does not
own** (MCP tools, profile-level plugin bundles, per-agent tool sets) is kept **out
of the model's context** and reached on demand from inside a program through one
extra tool, `code_run`.

Modelled on pi's codemode (`mode: on` + deferred MCP exposure), implemented on
top of DSH's own PTC runtime instead of a hand-rolled sandbox.

The rule is **registration scope**, not a name prefix: the preset's own plugin
  rows register in the preset's scope and stay native, while MCP servers and
  profile-level bundles live in the global layer and per-agent tool sets (Agent
  Teams, schedule) land in the agent layer — both are masked. The name rules
  (`hiddenPrefixes`, `hiddenTools`, `nativeTools`) still apply, for exceptions.

Every other mode (`standard`, `ptc`, `minimal`, `cordis`) is untouched: tools keep
their native presentation there.

| Plugin line | Target DSH | Program entry |
|---|---|---|
| `0.3.x` (`main`) | **0.2.2-alpha.3 and later** | this package's `code_run` transport **plus its own `ToolExecutor`** — the only seam that still masks |
| `0.2.x` (branch `0.2.x`) | **the whole 0.2.1 line** (`>=0.2.1-alpha.5 <0.2.2-0`) | this package's `code_run` transport; masking rides the preset row `mode: native` plus the `system-prompt/assemble` waterfall |
| `0.1.x` (branch `0.1.x`) | 0.2.0-rc.2, which still has `mode: both` | the built-in `run_code` that `both` adds; this package registers no transport |

All three lines behave the same way: standard tools stay native, and everything
outside the preset's own list (MCP, profile-level plugins, per-agent tool sets) is
reached only from inside a program.

**Why `0.2.x` and `0.3.x` are separate lines.** DSH `0.2.2-alpha.2` reworked tool
presentation, and four load-bearing assumptions of the `0.2.x` line broke at
once — all of them silently:

| `0.2.x` relied on | 0.2.2+ reality |
|---|---|
| `assembly.tools` inside the `system-prompt/assemble` waterfall | no longer passed in; `tools` is re-attached from the provider after the waterfall, so a listener cannot change it |
| `ctx.tools.execute({callId,name,arguments,...})` | takes a batch `{calls,agent,signal}` |
| `ctx.tools.executionMode(input)` | removed; moved to `ToolExecutionPipeline.executionMode()` |
| preset row `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-tool-presentation` `mode:native` | the package is deprecated and no longer a dependency of `dsh-web-app`/`dsh-base`; when absent the row `never started`, which **fails the whole preset activation** |
| snapshot row `dsh-tool-subagent-control/list-agents` | that subpath is no longer exported, which also fails preset activation |

`0.3.x` switches the seam to a **plugin-owned `ToolExecutor`**
(`ctx.tools.setExecutor()`): the registry asks the scope's executor for the
model-facing schemas, so `describe()` *is* the request surface — exactly what
masking needs, and a more legitimate owner of that surface than the old hook.
Install and configuration are identical across lines; the recipe is in
[docs/internals.en.md](./docs/internals.en.md#verification).

For local development, point `link:` at the checkout instead:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:<path-to-the-checkout>"
```

`cordis.patch.yml` mounts the preset; edit the `codemode` row's `config` to change
behaviour (omit a key, or set it to `null`, to take the default):

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `nativeScope` | `true` | Mask every tool the registry does not resolve from this preset's own scope (MCP, profile-level plugins, per-agent tool sets) |
| `hiddenPrefixes` | `['mcp__']` | Additional tool-name prefixes stripped from the request surface |
| `nativeTools` | `[]` | Exceptions: these names always stay native (`run_code` and `runToolName` always do) |
| `hiddenTools` | `[]` | Exceptions: these names are always masked |
| `metaTools` | `[list, search, describe, debug]` | Discovery tool names; the first doubles as the codemode marker |
| `runToolName` | `code_run` | Name of this package's transport tool (the reserved `run_code` is unavailable) |
| `searchLimit` | `8` | Default rows returned by `code_tools_search` |
| `maxDescriptionChars` | `240` | Truncation length for descriptions in listings |
| `maxParallelSubCalls` | `10` | Concurrent read-only sub-calls allowed inside one program |
| `guard` | `true` | Reject model-direct calls to masked tools |
| `sdkSection` | `true` | Inject / replace the Code Mode section |
| `debug` | `true` | Register the `code_debug` tool |

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-codemode
```

The preset row lives in this bundle's patch layer and disappears with the package.
Nothing outside the profile was ever modified.

- **The scope attribution leans on one DSH internal.** The registry exposes no
  "which scope registered this tool" API, so this package reads the tag
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope` writes onto a scoped context (by symbol description,
  `dsh.scope`) and then decides ownership through the public
  `ctx.tools.get(name, scope)` (`lib/scope.js`). When the tag is absent — this
  package mounted at the host level rather than inside a preset — the scope rule
  goes inert, one warn is logged, and only the name rules apply, so nothing is
  masked by mistake.
- **A name nobody attributes stays native.** A schema contributed by another prompt
  provider is in no registry layer, so no rule owns it and it keeps its place in
  the request; only tools whose ownership the registry confirms are masked.
  Since `0.3.x` there is one extra constraint: an executor's `describe()` does not
  receive the calling agent's scope, so **its input set is the agent view** — a
  name resolved by neither the global nor the preset view can only have been
  registered below the preset (the agent layer), and is judged on that basis
  (`resolveCatalogView`). That is more precise than the old hook because it reads
  the ex

Architecture, the retained-environment lifecycle, verification, and the upgrade
procedure live in [docs/internals.en.md](./docs/internals.en.md).
